datasets.title: Pandora's Cluster in near infrared
datasets.description: The James Webb Space Telescope's NIRCam mosaic of Pandora's Cluster, near-infrared light shown as colour, with the far galaxies the cluster's gravity magnifies. It stands as one flat picture facing the Sun at the cluster's distance.
datasets.summary: Webb's near-infrared view of the merging clusters and the far galaxies they magnify. A flat picture of the sky; no depth.

facts.label: Colours
facts.value: Near-infrared light shown as colour (Webb NIRCam): 1.15 and 1.5 µm blue, 2.0 and 2.77 µm green, 3.56 and 4.44 µm red
